### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

## Industries we serve

[

### Agriculture

Hexion’s innovative resin technologies enable controlled, slow-release fertilizers that improve
nutrient efficiency, crop yield, and environmental sustainability.

Read our case study

### Agriculture

][42][

### Automotive

Our high-performance resins and adhesives drive innovation in lighter, safer, and more
energy-efficient vehicles.

Read our case study

### Automotive

][43][

### Building Materials

High-performance materials engineered to improve strength, durability, and sustainability in modern
construction applications.

Read our case study

### Building Materials

][44][

### Coatings & Paint

Our advanced monomers enable durable, high-quality coatings with optimized performance and
compliance.

Read our case study

### Coatings & Paint

][45][

### Equipment Solutions

Integrated equipment and process solutions designed to enhance efficiency, reliability, and
performance in industrial operations.

Read our case study

### Equipment Solutions

][46][

### Formalin

Essential formalin solutions produced with a focus on quality, consistency, and responsible
manufacturing.

Read our case study

### Formalin

][47][

### Mining

Our robust systems improve safety, efficiency, and environmental performance in the world’s most
demanding extraction environments.

Read our case study

### Mining

][48][

### Oil & Gas

Hexion chemistry delivers strength and reliability under pressure—enhancing drilling performance,
well integrity, and operational safety.

Read our case study

### Oil & Gas

][49][

### Wood Panels

Innovative resin systems designed to improve panel performance, productivity, and sustainability
across wood-based products.

Read our case study

### Wood Panels

][50]

## Science with Purpose, Sustainability with Soul.

At Hexion, we don’t make empty promises; we drive measurable, year-over-year progress to protect our
environment and empower the professionals who are behind it.

Shrinking Our Footprint,
Not Our Ambition

By prioritizing energy efficiency and circularity, we aim for measurable reductions in emissions and
resource use every single year, even if that means rethinking our legacy formulas from the ground
up.

With you anything is possible

We are looking for the curious, the bold, and the nerds who want to question the status quo. If you
are ready to grow, we provide the safety, well-being, and technical tools to help you reach your
full potential.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

#### ABOUT EVERGREEN

Evergreen is a company that brings together talents in the chemical industry. We have been paying
attention to the construction of industry talent pipelines. We focus on unsaturated polyester
resins, epoxy resin, vinyl resins, specialty additives, organic peroxides and other fields. We are
committed to brand development and evangelism, senior brand managers will use critical eyes to help
you find suitable solutions. Evergreen's talent pool continues to expand, not only limited to
Nouryon, AOC , Henkel, China Sinochem, Fuchen, Jushi, Ineos..........
"Insist on loyalty and sincerity as our core value"
As partners continue to learn and innovate, Evergreen will eventually become the cradle of chemical
experts.

[Learn More][151]

#### OUR MAIN PRODUCTS

Evergreen Chemicals Group is committed to be deeply involved in the composite materials industry and
to be the most reliable one-stop partener of our clients.

Our products lines are unsaturated polyester resin series, vinyl ester resin series, epoxy resin
series, organic peroxides series, as well as the glass fiber mats series. We mainly work with the
top famous brands in the world like Nouryon, Inoes, BASF, AOC and so on.

[Learn More][152]

#### OUR ADVANTAGES

1. Efficient Export Process: We provide full export certificates promptly, ensuring a streamlined
export process and allowing for faster delivery times.
2. Global Reach: With no district limitations, we have the capability to export our chemicals to
every corner of the world.
3. Technical Expertise: Our team consists of professionals with strong technical backgrounds.
4. Supply Reliability: We understand the importance of providing hot chemicals and addressing the
demand for short-supply chemicals.
5. Customer Trust and Global Market Presence: Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction
has earned us the trust of our clients.

#### OUR MARKETS

Evergreen Chemicals are experienced in exporting dangerous products to other countries. We deal with
clients from over 50 countries in the world. Evergreen Chemicals always keeps eyes on the newest
exporting policy on dangerous products to assure the delivery rate. Besides, multiple payment ways
are offered to clients.

film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

## WHY ACP COMPOSITES?

Since 1985, ACP Composites has specialized in designing and manufacturing custom composite
structures, plates, flat panels, and other customized products that change the way the world
approaches complex operating environments. By following the basic principle of “customer-centric
innovation,” ACP Composites has remained focused on developing products that meet the specialty
needs of customers in high-performance and critical industries. With a penchant for high-quality
composites, affordable options, and decades of successful customer partnerships under its belt, ACP
is driven to become the leading custom composite manufacturer for clients in the aerospace,
recreational, medical, and industrial sectors.

## Our Products

[AddCell][18]

Tailored robotic cell solutions with flexible configurations, stringent safety standards, and
end-to-end integration to elevate your manufacturing efficiency and safety.

[ADD Filament Winding System][19]

Versatile winding system for Towpreg, Thermoset, Thermoplastic, Dry fiber materials. Functions as
AFP or Filament Winding as per geometry & material needs. Enables faster and precise production of
pressure vessels, sleeves, inserts.

[AddPath][20]

Streamline and optimize automated composite production with tailored path planning, simulation, and
real-time monitoring for precision and efficiency in fiber placement.

[AddPrint][21]

Advanced slicing and path generation software for SCF3D, designed to optimize Continuous Fiber 3D
printing with best practice-driven functionality and control.

[ADDX][22]

Revolutionizing 3D printing with Structural Continuous Fiber for enhanced strength, precision, and
material efficiency in functional component manufacturing.

[AFP-X][23]

Reduce downtime and increases throughput, the AFP-X offers a four-tow system with increased capacity
& advanced sensors for high-volume manufacturing.

[AFP-XS][24]

The flagship AFP-XS system is a versatile, compact, and precise automated fiber placement solution
ideal for research or small scale production.

## Testimonials

[qt-small ]
Material Versatility
Françis Sedeilhan, Compositadour

The AFP-XS is a high quality, easy to use, repeatable system that quickly swaps over from a standard
thermoset system to handle dry fibers and thermoplastics, seamlessly integrating with the humm3.
This will enable us to further develop the fiber placement research and local SME activity at
Compositadour. We are excited to collaborate with Addcomposites.

[qt-small ]
Smart & Compact AFP Tool
Cyran Le Guennec, IRMA

The AFP-XS is a smart and compact AFP process tool. IRMA has clearly found it useful for composite
prototyping and custom production of material testing. AddPath offers a user-friendly interface for
programming and simulating lay-up. The Addcomposites team clearly knows the way to properly meet the
need of their customer at any time.

[qt-small ]
Efficient Integration
Rik Tonnaer, SAM|XL

Addcomposites has successfully and efficiently integrated their tool into an existing robot cell
with a complex layout, and with much legacy equipment already integrated. We look forward to working
with Addcomposites, continuously sharing knowledge at TU Delft.

[qt-small ]
Project Vision Alignment
Yoann Bonnefon, IND Group

IND Group has chosen to partner with Addcomposites with the goal of developing a complete composites
manufacturing cell using the AFP-XS. It is the only fiber placement system that fit our
requirements, and the vision was aligned from the start.

[qt-small ]
Improved Employee Safety
Jussi Valtonen, Exel Composites

Addcomposites was given the goal of improving employee safety by process automation. With their
innovative approach, technical know-how, and professional communication, they have delivered the
project successfully and in a timely manner.

# AEROVAC PROCESS MATERIALS

Aerovac is a** leading provider of process materials** essential to composite manufacturing in
Aerospace, Wind Energy, Marine, Motorsports and more. Products are efficiently delivered from **40+
distribution centers** across North America via our exclusive fleet of **privately owned trucks**.
Locations in the UK, Italy, France and South America combined with a network of authorized
distributors ensure Aerovac products are readily available worldwide. Our team of over
100 **technical product experts** can help your business innovate utilizing industry leading
technologies and composite supplies.

As a top composite process materials manufacturer, companies across a broad spectrum of industries
depend on our expertise. Whether it’s for Aerospace, Marine, Motorsports or Wind Energy, our
customers rely on us as their process materials manufacturer of choice. We’re entrusted to meet
their specific requirements to deliver the highest degrees of performance and reliability. As a
leading process materials supplier, our products serve an important role in manufacturing processes
such as vacuum bagging, prepreg processing, vacuum infusion, and more.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

*ABOUT US*

##### Composite Material Manufacturing:

Haining ANJIE Composite Materials Co. Ltd., is a reputable and established manufacturer of composite
materials,specializing in the production of carbon fiber,basalt fiber,aramid fiber,and fiberglass
products. With a strong presence in Haining City Zhejiang province,China since its establishment in
2004,ANJIE has built a robust brand known for its competitive pricing,superior quality,and
exceptional customer service with 20 years of experience in composite materials industry. Jiangsu
NONGCHAOER Composite Materials Co. Ltd.,is a dynamic and forward-thinking sister company of ANJIE
Composite,established in 2019 and located in Jianhu High-tech Park,Yancheng City,Jiangsu Province
with a total area of about 20,000 square meters. With a commitment to excellence and
innovation,NONGCHAOER focuses on the manufacturing,development and application of advanced composite
materials to meet the growing demand in the market worldwide. Equipped with large facilities and
advanced machinery,it currently has more than 120 sets of various types of production equipment and
laboratory equipment. In 2022,it successfully passed the certification of "National Science and
Technology small and medium-sized enterprises",in 2023 it successfully passed the quality management
system certification,environmental management system certification,occupational health and safety
management system certification,SGS certification,and selected as the first batch of Yancheng
Engineering Technology Research Center.

## Main Product

All of our products comply with international quality standards and are greatly appreciated in a
variety of different markets throughout the world.

### Glass Fiber Products

Durable and lightweight, our glass fiber products offer exceptional thermal insulation and corrosion
resistance, making them ideal for various industrial and construction applications.
[ View More ][26]

### Basalt Fiber Products

Crafted from volcanic basalt rock, our basalt fiber products provide excellent strength, durability,
and heat resistance, perfect for demanding environments and high-performance applications.
[ View More ][27]

### Aramid Fiber Products

Known for their outstanding strength and heat resistance, our aramid fiber products are perfect for
advanced applications requiring superior durability and protection, such as aerospace and military
uses.
[ View More ][28]

### Carbon Fiber Products

Lightweight yet incredibly strong, our carbon fiber products offer high stiffness and excellent
fatigue resistance, ideal for high-performance applications in automotive, aerospace, and sports
industries.
[ View More ][29]

## Industry Applications

Fibremax offers fiber reinforced composite materials solutions with primary applications in
technical textiles for the construction, electrical, electronics, industrial, and transportation
sectors, among others.

[Glass fiber tissue enhance construction materials]

### Construction

Glass fiber tissue enhance construction materials with strength, fire resistance, and dimensional
stability. When combined with asphalt, they create an ideal waterproofing material.

[Carbon fiber used in cars]

### Automotive

Carbon fiber is a strong, lightweight material used in cars to improve performance. It's used to
make parts like the car's frame and body, as well as interior components.

[Aramid used in aerospace]

### Aerospace

Aramid is a very strong and heat-resistant material used in airplanes. Aramid is used to make parts
of the plane like the wings and body. It's also used to protect sensitive equipment.

[Carbon Fiber and Glass Fiber in Wind Turbines]

### Wind Energy

Carbon fiber and glass fiber are strong but lightweight materials used to make wind turbine blades.
Carbon fiber is stronger and helps bigger wind turbines make more power.

## CIKONI: CFK-Engineering für Pioniere

CIKONI ist ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurbüro für innovative Leichtbau- und Faserverbundlösungen mit
fortgeschrittenen Verbundwerkstoffen, wie kohlefaserverstärktem Kunststoff (CFK).

CIKONI – das bedeutet ganzheitliche spezialisierte Ingenieurdienstleistungen entlang der gesamten
Prozesskette und schließt die Entwicklung von Leichtbauprodukten und den notwendigen
Fertigungsverfahren ein. Mit unserem Expertenteam schließen wir im Kundenauftrag Technologie- und
Wissenslücken und realisieren einen meßbaren Beitrag zu geringerem Energieverbrauch, höherer
Performance und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Zur Detaillierung und Absicherung von Strukturkomponenten nutzen wir modernste
Konstruktionswerkzeuge, zukunftsweisende Simulationsmethoden und fasergerechte FEM-Berechnung (z.B.
Festigkeit, Steifigkeit, Crash). In der Prozessentwicklung realisieren wir skalierbare und
automatisierbare Lösungen für die effiziente Fertigung von Carbonbauteilen.

[FEM Simulation von CFK Bauteilen]

## Was machen wir im CFK-Leichtbau?

[ Leichtbau][32] [ Testing][33] [ Automation][34] [ Drucktanks][35]

Leichtbau ist ein Entwicklungsprinzip, bei dem wir die Erfüllung einer Funktion mit möglichst
geringem Einsatz an Material und damit Gewicht realisieren. Dabei setzen wir sowohl
leichtbaubezogene Konstruktionsprinzipien als auch Hochleistungswerkstoffe wie CFK/Carbon ein, um
das Gewichtsziel zu erreichen. Ein wichtiges Werkzeug ist die anisotrope Finite Elemente Simulation,
die es uns erlaubt Konzepte frühzeitig zu validieren und in späten Projektphasen weitgehend zu
optimieren.

Unser übergeordnetes Ziel ist es dabei , das richtige wirtschaftliches Maß für jeden Kunden zu
finden. Zwischen Ultraleichtbau, wie er im Rennsport oder der Luftfahrt praktiziert wird und einer
reinen Optimierung identifizieren wir die richtige Stufe für jeden Kunden und jeden Anwendungsfall.
Dabei dienen uns Hybridkonstruktionen aus Metall und Verbundwerkstoffen oftmals als Enabler.

Mehr zur [Entwicklung von CFK-Bauteilen][36].

Für den Leichtbau spielt das Testing für uns eine doppelte Rolle. Einerseits sind wir gerade bei
komplexen Faserverbundwerkstoffen auf umfangreiche Inputdaten für die Simulation angewiesen.
Andererseits werden Leichtbauteile oftmals an die Grenzen ihrer Belastbarkeit hin entwickelt. Daher
müssen sie über Komponentenversuche bezüglich ihrer Funktionserfüllung validiert werden.

Bei CIKONI arbeiten wir mit mehr als 20 verschiedenen Laboren, Prüfzentren und Versuchseinrichtungen
zusammen. Dies erlaubt uns die durchgängige Realisierung von Versuchen vom Coupon bis zum
Systemversuch zu wirtschaftlichen Konditionen und mit durchgängiger technischer Begleitung anbieten
zu können.

Mehr zum [Testing mit Verbundwerkstoffen][37].

Der Großteil der Fertigung von Carbon Composites erfolgt nach wie vor über manuelle
Fertigungsverfahren. Die Kosten manueller Fertigung übersteigen dabei die Materialkosten um ein
Vielfaches. Bei CIKONI entwickeln wir daher sowohl Leichtbauteile, die effizient gefertigt werden
können, realisieren aber auch Fertigungsprozesse und automatisierte Maschinen für die Herstellung
der Komponenten.

Ein besonderer Fokus ist dabei die Skalierbarkeit unserer Fertigungskonzepte, so dass mit
überschaubaren Mitteln ein Einstieg in die (Teil-)Automatisierung erfolgen kann, das
Fertigungsprinzip jedoch bei Bedarf multipliziert werden kann. Unser Schwerpunkt sind die
Entwicklung innovativer Verfahren, das automatisierte Preforming und die Fertigung auf Basis der
Wickeltechnologie.

Mehr zur [Automatisierung im Leichtbau][38].

# Composite Materials Development & Manufacturing

### Design Engineer

Work with our engineers to optimize the design to achieve the best results using composites. This
includes part consolidation compared to other traditional styles.

### Tool Build

CME will build your tools to deliver your program on time and on budget and work closely with our
tool suppliers both nationally and internationally.

### Material Development

CME will formulate a material to meet unique requirements for structural performance, impact
absorption, food safe, fire resistance, electrical insulation.

### Material Compounding

CME will manufacture you engineered raw materials in-house to ensure the quality. This gives our
customers a unique difference over imports and competitors.

### Validation

CME will validate materials and design before the tool build allowing for any changes to improve
performance to be made.

### Manufacture

CME will manufacture and assemble your product if required. This can also include painting with a
Class A finish. We will also provide ongoing engineering support.

## INNOVATION IN COMPOSITE TECHNOLOGIES

We pride ourselves in being the leaders in composite materials with the most up to date technology
in both materials and manufacturing processes to offer our customers a competitive advantage in
their industry.

During past few years composite materials have been gradually developed and spread in numerous
fields of Industry. From the beginning composites were created as materials with specials features
for aeronautical and military fields, but now they are widely spread in a number of civil
applications such as automotive, marine, wind energy, construction, water treatment and many others.

**18th Exhibition "Composite-Expo"** is a unique exhibition event in Russia and is a platform for
development and introduction of composite technologies and materials in different branches of
industry. Many Russian and foreign companies participate in the event such as Technologiya ONPP,
RT-Khimkompozit, Stupino Glass Reinforced Plastics Plant, Akzo Nobel N.V., Evonik, OCV Steklovolokno
(OCV Reinforcements) are already exhibitors of the event.

** **

**The event purpose is defined by three components:**
* Industrial and Economic Relations' Development;
* Scientific and Technical Information Exchange;
* Wide introduction and application of innovative technologies of composite materials manufacturing
  and introduction.

# Manufacturing Software for Composite Materials

Transform your composite manufacturing processes with **CompositeOS **- where advanced manufacturing
**planning and operating software** meet in the cloud. Designed for the unique needs of the
composite industry, our platform delivers superior optimized planning, traceability, and operational
efficiency. CompositeOS is your manufacturing company's new operating backbone.

###### Navigating the Complexity of Fiber-Reinforced Materials

## Composite Materials are complex. So is Manufacturing.

[ Read more about us][8]

In the dynamic world of composite materials, where **performance**, **know how**, and the relentless
pursuit of **perfection **are not just goals but the essence of every endeavor. Handling
fiber-reinforced materials requires not just skill but a passion for pushing the boundaries of
what’s possible, blending an array of materials through processes that are as complex as they are
critical. Every step, every decision, reflects a commitment to excellence, with the quality of your
output distinguishing groundbreaking success from the ordinary.

In this intricate dance of precision, where **countless individuals, suppliers, materials, and
machines** come together to weave the very fabric of tomorrow’s structures, CompositeOS emerges as
the perfect tool to manage this complexity. Crafted exclusively for the nuanced demands of composite
material manufacturing, it is more than software—it is a celebration of the industry’s unyielding
drive towards perfection.

###### Designed for Composite Materials Manufacturing

## Made by Composite Materials Experts for your Success.

Composite materials competence, software expertise and customer orientation from a single source.

Whether you manufacture components using the autoclave prepreg process or resin transfer moulding,
we have the composite-specific tools, customizable modules and expertise to digitalize your
processes. In addition, compositeOS offers a number of characteristics that are aimed precisely at
the success of your composite materials business.

[ How it works][9]

##### (Cost-) Efficiency

We believe software must be affordable and deliver measurable efficiency boosts for your operation.

##### Transparency and Oversight

In composites, oversight is key. We provide software based tools to track customer acquisition,
manufacturing progress and quality metrics.

##### Convenience and Support

Typically, software is not a core competence of composite manufacturers. That’s why we devote time
to consult our customers, plan the project transparently and provide support beyond implementation.

##### Digital Empowerment

Digital processes increase employee satisfaction, boost efficiency and offer unlimited new business
opportunities through higher customer satisfaction.

###### Your Composite business reinforced by a digital thread

## A few things we’re great at

##### Fast Quoting

Use smart automation for fast quoting of composite manufacturing projects based on CAD files and ply
books. Change flexibly as you wish.
* Unbeaten speed to generate project proposals with AI Support
* Unlimited flexibility to change proposals
* Automated analysis of geometry, complexity and composite-specific features

##### Project Scheduling

Dynamically plan your production process according to your available resources and automatically
determined working times.
* Drag and drop ressources or tasks and compositeOS will reschedule automatically
* Get instant optimization feedback and work more efficiently
* Define endless templates for projects to plan faster in a reconfigurable way

##### Project Tracking

Our tracking tool allows you to track progress depending on teams, batch sizes or other logics and
to monitor the entire manufacturing process.
* Role based assignments of tasks and processes
* Track projects, teams, ressources and dead lines
* From autoclave to stacking: Made for composite manufacturing

przez firmę Aircraft New Generation Patriot . Bazuje na wcześniejszym modelu LA-50, ale jest

światowymi produktami w klasie lekkiej awiacji ogólnej (general aviation). Wyposażony w chowane
podwozie, silnik Rotax 915 iS (141 KM) oraz nowoczesną awionikę.

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

* Founded in 1986

## Dal 1961 un mondo di compositi

Pre-Preg, Laminati termoindurenti, Reti impregnate,Reti per applicazioni strutturali, Resine e
formulazioni speciali.

## Scopri di più su di noi

[
][24]

## SETTORI

Le molteplici applicazioni dei nostri compositi

[Railway Icon]

Ferroviario

Laminati e Pre-Preg utilizzati nell’industria ferroviaria.

[Energy icon]

Energia

Nell’ambito dei trasformatori elettrici, reti in fibra di vetro per inglobamento in resina.

[Icon composites]

Compositi

Formulazioni hotmelt o a solvente per molteplici applicazioni, anche in ambito tecnico sportivo.

[Naval Icon]

Navale

Laminati e Pre-Preg utilizzati nell’industria navale.

[Construction Icon]

Edile

Rinforzi strutturali per costruzioni civili esistenti e riqualificazioni.

[Industrial icon]

Meccanico ed Industriale

Laminati termoindurenti per applicazioni meccaniche o dielettriche.

## PRODOTTI

[**Vai ai nostri prodotti** ][25]
[[Rotolo di pre-preg]][26]
[Icona pre-preg]

## Pre-preg

Impregnazione di tessuti di cotone, fibre di vetro, poliestere, arammidiche, carbonio. Formulati con
resine fenoliche, epossidiche, termoplastiche con personalizzazioni ad hoc secondo le esigenze del
cliente.

[scopri di più][27]
[[Lastra di laminato termoindurente]][28]
[Icona Laminati]

## Laminati termoindurenti

Per utilizzi meccanici e dielettrici, realizziamo lastre con spessori da ca. 0,2 a 100 mm; formato
ca. 1230 x 2030 mm e presto sarà disponibile anche un nuovo formato ca. 1230 x 2500 mm. Su specifica
richiesta possiamo proporre grandi formati larghezza massima 1570 mm e lunghezza massima 5500 mm.

[scopri di più][29]
[[reti impregnate per trasformatori]][30]
[Icona rete impregnata]

## Reti impregnate per trasformatori

Reti in fibra di vetro impregnate con resine epossidiche. Tramite una speciale cottura risultano
polimerizzate completamente e consentono di rientrare in classe H, con resistenze termiche >200°C,
idonee per la costruzione di trasformatori in classe F1.

[scopri di più][31]
[[Rinforzi strutturali]][32]
[Icona rinforzo strutturale]

## Rinforzi strutturali

Impregnazione di speciali reti in fibre di vetro, carbonio, kevlar, per inglobamenti sia nel campo
dei materiali compositi che delle strutture civili.

[scopri di più][33]
[[immagine di resina termoindurente]][34]
[Icona resina]

## Resine Termoindurenti

Con modernissimi reattori e miscelatori prepariamo e formuliamo resine e miscele di resine. Vendiamo
inoltre preparazioni formulate ad hoc sulle esigenze applicative del cliente.

[scopri di più][35]
[[Esempi di tessuto in fibra di vetro]][36]
[Icona Fiberglass fabrics]

## Tessuti in fibra di vetro

Tessuti e reti di rinforzo.

[scopri di più][37]

## Benvenuti nel mondo

[LOGO CONDORDIELETRIC]

“Amiamo investire il nostro tempo per capire al meglio le vostre esigenze”

## Mission

Attivi da oltre 60 anni nel settore dei pre-impregnati, isolanti elettrici e materiali compositi,
sviluppiamo e realizziamo nella nostra sede produttiva materiali specifici per ogni applicazione
(elettromeccanica, elettrica e per il rinforzo strutturale). Forniamo inoltre assistenza tecnica in
molteplici settori.

[Scopri di più][38]

## Ricerca e sviluppo

Crediamo fermamente nella ricerca scientifica come strumento per una produzione qualitativa e ci
avvaliamo di macchinari all’avanguardia (di precisione) per lo sviluppo e la personalizzazione dei
nostri prodotti.

[Scopri di più][39]

## SERVIZI

“Il nostro obiettivo è aiutarvi a scegliere il prodotto che più si addice alle vostre esigenze,
garantendo una soddisfazione finale che riteniamo essere la nostra miglior pubblicità”

## Qualità

Eseguiamo test di controllo speciali utilizzando attrezzature di laboratorio innovative.

Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC)

Thermal-Mechanical Analysis (TMA)

Thermal-Dynamic-Mechanical Analysis (DMA)

Rheometer

## Certificazioni

CONDORDIELETRIC è certificata ISO 9001 : 2015 e opera secondo gli standard tecnici e ambientali per
garantire la migliore qualità ai propri clienti.

[Certificazione ISO 9001:2015]

## Assistenza

Siamo in grado di fornire assistenza tecnica in molti settori, sviluppando materiali specifici per
ogni l’applicazione.

[Immagine per servizio di supporto]

## PRODOTTI

[**Vai ai nostri prodotti** ][25]
[[Rotolo di pre-preg]][26]
[Icona pre-preg]

## Pre-preg

Impregnazione di tessuti di cotone, fibre di vetro, poliestere, arammidiche, carbonio. Formulati con
resine fenoliche, epossidiche, termoplastiche con personalizzazioni ad hoc secondo le esigenze del
cliente.

[scopri di più][27]
[[Lastra di laminato termoindurente]][28]
[Icona Laminati]

## Laminati termoindurenti

Per utilizzi meccanici e dielettrici, realizziamo lastre con spessori da ca. 0,2 a 100 mm; formato
ca. 1230 x 2030 mm e presto sarà disponibile anche un nuovo formato ca. 1230 x 2500 mm. Su specifica
richiesta possiamo proporre grandi formati larghezza massima 1570 mm e lunghezza massima 5500 mm.

[scopri di più][29]
[[reti impregnate per trasformatori]][30]
[Icona rete impregnata]

## Reti impregnate per trasformatori

Reti in fibra di vetro impregnate con resine epossidiche. Tramite una speciale cottura risultano
polimerizzate completamente e consentono di rientrare in classe H, con resistenze termiche >200°C,
idonee per la costruzione di trasformatori in classe F1.

[scopri di più][31]
[[Rinforzi strutturali]][32]
[Icona rinforzo strutturale]

## Rinforzi strutturali

Impregnazione di speciali reti in fibre di vetro, carbonio, kevlar, per inglobamenti sia nel campo
dei materiali compositi che delle strutture civili.

[scopri di più][33]
[[immagine di resina termoindurente]][34]
[Icona resina]

## Resine Termoindurenti

Con modernissimi reattori e miscelatori prepariamo e formuliamo resine e miscele di resine. Vendiamo
inoltre preparazioni formulate ad hoc sulle esigenze applicative del cliente.

[scopri di più][35]
[[Esempi di tessuto in fibra di vetro]][36]
[Icona Fiberglass fabrics]

## Tessuti in fibra di vetro

Tessuti e reti di rinforzo.

[scopri di più][37]

## Benvenuti nel mondo

[LOGO CONDORDIELETRIC]

“Amiamo investire il nostro tempo per capire al meglio le vostre esigenze”

## Mission

Attivi da oltre 60 anni nel settore dei pre-impregnati, isolanti elettrici e materiali compositi,
sviluppiamo e realizziamo nella nostra sede produttiva materiali specifici per ogni applicazione
(elettromeccanica, elettrica e per il rinforzo strutturale). Forniamo inoltre assistenza tecnica in
molteplici settori.

[Scopri di più][38]

## Ricerca e sviluppo

Crediamo fermamente nella ricerca scientifica come strumento per una produzione qualitativa e ci
avvaliamo di macchinari all’avanguardia (di precisione) per lo sviluppo e la personalizzazione dei
nostri prodotti.

[Scopri di più][39]

## SERVIZI

“Il nostro obiettivo è aiutarvi a scegliere il prodotto che più si addice alle vostre esigenze,
garantendo una soddisfazione finale che riteniamo essere la nostra miglior pubblicità”

## Qualità

Eseguiamo test di controllo speciali utilizzando attrezzature di laboratorio innovative.

Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC)

Thermal-Mechanical Analysis (TMA)

Thermal-Dynamic-Mechanical Analysis (DMA)

Rheometer

## Certificazioni

CONDORDIELETRIC è certificata ISO 9001 : 2015 e opera secondo gli standard tecnici e ambientali per
garantire la migliore qualità ai propri clienti.

[Certificazione ISO 9001:2015]

Siamo in grado di fornire assistenza tecnica in molti settori, sviluppando materiali specifici per
ogni l’applicazione.

Industry-Recognized Composite Manufacturing Facilities

At Jiangyin Dongli New Materials Technology Co., Ltd., we have built a robust manufacturing base
covering 32,000㎡ to serve the evolving demands of industries worldwide. Our facilities are equipped
with advanced technology and tailored workflows, ensuring the higher standards in composite material
production.

**Precision environment:** Constant temperature workshop and 1.100,000-grade purification area to
ensure material integrity and production accuracy.

**Full range of capabilities:** From fiber weaving to prepreg production to integrated production of
advanced forming technologies such as RTM, 2.vacuum infusion and hot pressing.

**Sustainable processes:** Efficient use of resources and innovative design ensure environmentally
friendly production.

**High capacity:** The loom has a daily output of 4,000㎡, supported by an autonomous tension
control and feeding system.

Our facilities not only represent efficient manufacturing but also demonstrate our commitment to
advancing composite technology. By continuously investing in our infrastructure, we aim to redefine
both performance and sustainability in the industry.

#### ABOUT EVERGREEN

Evergreen is a company that brings together talents in the chemical industry. We have been paying
attention to the construction of industry talent pipelines. We focus on unsaturated polyester
resins, epoxy resin, vinyl resins, specialty additives, organic peroxides and other fields. We are
committed to brand development and evangelism, senior brand managers will use critical eyes to help
you find suitable solutions. Evergreen's talent pool continues to expand, not only limited to
Nouryon, AOC , Henkel, China Sinochem, Fuchen, Jushi, Ineos..........
"Insist on loyalty and sincerity as our core value"
As partners continue to learn and innovate, Evergreen will eventually become the cradle of chemical
experts.

[Learn More][151]

#### OUR MAIN PRODUCTS

Evergreen Chemicals Group is committed to be deeply involved in the composite materials industry and
to be the most reliable one-stop partener of our clients.

Our products lines are unsaturated polyester resin series, vinyl ester resin series, epoxy resin
series, organic peroxides series, as well as the glass fiber mats series. We mainly work with the
top famous brands in the world like Nouryon, Inoes, BASF, AOC and so on.

[Learn More][152]

#### OUR ADVANTAGES

1. Efficient Export Process: We provide full export certificates promptly, ensuring a streamlined
export process and allowing for faster delivery times.
2. Global Reach: With no district limitations, we have the capability to export our chemicals to
every corner of the world.
3. Technical Expertise: Our team consists of professionals with strong technical backgrounds.
4. Supply Reliability: We understand the importance of providing hot chemicals and addressing the
demand for short-supply chemicals.
5. Customer Trust and Global Market Presence: Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction
has earned us the trust of our clients.

#### OUR MARKETS

Evergreen Chemicals are experienced in exporting dangerous products to other countries. We deal with
clients from over 50 countries in the world. Evergreen Chemicals always keeps eyes on the newest
exporting policy on dangerous products to assure the delivery rate. Besides, multiple payment ways
are offered to clients.

# The FREE science and technology book

[CCD chip from a webcam.]

Want to know why giant ships can float, how your earbuds make music, what graphene is, or how
windows can clean themselves? You've come to the right place! Here you'll find simple explanations
you can really understand—hurrah!

## Hard stuff... made simple!

[Model of a steam turbine at Think Tank science museum, Birmingham, England.]

Explain that Stuff is an online book written by science writer [Chris Woodford][9] (author of many
popular science books for adults and children). It includes over 400 easy-to-understand articles,
richly illustrated with over 4000 photos, artworks, and animations, covering how things work,
cutting-edge science, cool gadgets, and computers. We take the "pain" from explain and the "tough"
out of stuff! There's more information on this website than in your average expensive science book,
it's 100% human written (absolutely no "AI slop"), it's continually updated, and it's completely
free to use! Explain that Stuff also helps to support [curriculum learning][10] (conventional STEM
education and home-schooling).

## How to use this site

There are five simple ways to find what you want:
1. [A-Z index][11]: Browse articles by name.
2. [Timeline][12]: Find inventions by date.
3. [Random][13]: Discover something new.
4. [Search][14]: Use the search engine (at the top of each page).
5. [Teaching guide][15]: Browse study topics.

## What's new?

Some of our newest and most recently updated articles...

[Chromatography makes ink smudge on wet paper.]

### [Chromatography][16]

One of the most important techniques for separating and analyzing chemicals... is 120 years old!

[Dark red sunrise over Dorset, England.]

### [Solar cells][17]

How did solar become the world's favourite new form of power... and what does the future hold for
it?

[How a hybrid car works.]

### [Electric cars][18]

Are they as good as the hype? Are they as clean and green as people claim? Why are they taking so
long to catch on?

[Concept of artificial intelligence: an AI dummy superimposed on a green circuit board.]

### [Artificial intelligence][19]

Can we imagine a world where computers are smart enough not to need us? Is "human intelligence" a
good starting point for designing useful machines?

[The force of gravity is slightly greater at the equator than at the poles airplane.]

### [Gravity][20]

It's taken over two millenia for people to understand how gravity holds the universe together. What
do we know so far about this most mysterious of forces?

[Orange Schlieren photograph of two supersonic jets flying upward]

## Hard stuff... made simple!

[Model of a steam turbine at Think Tank science museum, Birmingham, England.]

Explain that Stuff is an online book written by science writer [Chris Woodford][9] (author of many

richly illustrated with over 4000 photos, artworks, and animations, covering how things work,
cutting-edge science, cool gadgets, and computers. We take the "pain" from explain and the "tough"
out of stuff! There's more information on this website than in your average expensive science book,
it's 100% human written (absolutely no "AI slop"), it's continually updated, and it's completely
free to use! Explain that Stuff also helps to support [curriculum learning][10] (conventional STEM
education and home-schooling).

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly

# Your next dream job is here

Hirify is a job board and meta-aggregator of the best IT and Digital jobs.  Why Hirify is different
* We collect directly from career pages - we take vacancies straight from company sites, including
  custom career sites other aggregators do not reach.

  here before they do on other platforms, including the big ones.
* Deduplication across 960+ Telegram channels - catches around 90% of duplicates, so the same job
  posted across dozens of channels usually does not repeat in your feed. We match title and company,
  contacts, vector similarity, and AI checks the borderline pairs.
* Smart filter - 15+ parameters (specialization, stack, domain, English, format, company type, geo),
  each with an exclude mode. You can also build the filter just by typing - AI parses a
  plain-language request.
* Telegram alerts - save as many filters as you want and get notified across all of them.
  Deduplication works here too: if a vacancy matches several of your filters, it arrives once, not
  as duplicates.

# Your next dream job is here

Hirify is a job board and meta-aggregator of the best IT and Digital jobs.  Why Hirify is different
* We collect directly from career pages - we take vacancies straight from company sites, including

  here before they do on other platforms, including the big ones.
* Deduplication across 960+ Telegram channels - catches around 90% of duplicates, so the same job
  posted across dozens of channels usually does not repeat in your feed. We match title and company,
  contacts, vector similarity, and AI checks the borderline pairs.
* Smart filter - 15+ parameters (specialization, stack, domain, English, format, company type, geo),
  each with an exclude mode. You can also build the filter just by typing - AI parses a
  plain-language request.
* Telegram alerts - save as many filters as you want and get notified across all of them.
  Deduplication works here too: if a vacancy matches several of your filters, it arrives once, not
  as duplicates.

# Welcome to Technovotum

## We develop and produce non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment

[Get Started][8]

#### [Portable Flaw detectors][9]

Our flaw detectors have shown great performance with their reliability at critical industries by
testing composite materials.

#### [Transducers and Probes][10]

Our transducers are available in a range of testing methods, frequencies, inclination allowing to
meet all requirements of testing standards. Ultrasonic, Eddy Current, Impedance, Phased array,
Immersion transducers are available for nearly any application.

#### [Robotic testing systems][11]

Robotic testing systems are vital for continuous high frequent operations. They are customized
depending on the test piece parameters and can be integrated in flow production process.

#### [Contact us][12]

Our team is ready to help with your enquiries.

## About

### Find Out More About Us

Technovotum сompany is a developer and manufacturer of non-destructive testing equipment for PCM
(polymer composite materials) products and materials. The company provides services for measurement
and diagnostics of PCM (polymer composite materials), supplies portable diagnostic equipment for
laboratories of PCM (polymer composite materials) manufacturers. We manufacture automated
non-destructive testing systems for PCM (polymer composite materials) and their implementation in
customer's production line.

### Technovotum is a developer and manufacturer of non-destructive testing equipment.

We carry out comprehensive non-destructive testing of products and materials made of PCM (polymer
composite materials).

We provide services for measurement and diagnostics of PCM (polymer composite materials), the supply
of portable diagnostic equipment for laboratories of PCM (polymer composite materials)
manufacturers.
* The portable equipment of Technovotum company is intended for detection of delamination,
  non-adhesives and other integrity failures of polymer-composite materials (PCM), cellular
  structures with various fillers, as well as for determination of corrosion origins, surface and
  subsurface defects in metal structures.
* We manufacture automated non-destructive testing systems for PCM (polymer composite materials) and
  implement them in the customer's production line. Technovotum robotic test benches are designed
  for testing parts made of polymer-composite materials (PCM) used in the aircraft industry:
  airframe elements, helicopter blades, honeycomb panels, as well as wind power, small-scale
  shipbuilding, pipe fittings, automotive industry, etc.
  
  All operations for selection and change of working tools (laser scanner, sensors) in the test
  benches are performed automatically.

## Application

### Application Industries

Six key industries are consumers of PCM (polymer composite materials)

#### [Aerospace][13]

Power structures of housing elements, thermal protection coating, housing panels.

#### [Shipbuilding][14]

Hull structures, foundation frames for engines, fairings of surface ships and submarines,
vibration-insulating coupling joints.

#### [Automotive Industry][15]

Power structures of doors and seats: protective elements of bottom, bumper and radiator mounting
elements, trunk lids, body panels and body elements, brake discs, thermal and sound insulation.

#### [Wind Power Industry][16]

Propeller blades, rotor cap, pods.

#### [Helicopter construction][17]

Main rotor and tail rotor blades, power elements and fuselage skin, sound and vibration isolation.

#### [Aircraft construction][18]

Fuselage, wings, tail, engine pod and interior details.

### Impedance

#### testing method

Application of impedance method in bonded structures with metal and non-metal sheaths with a
thickness of 1.2—1.5 mm (for steel) and up to 2.5 mm for aluminum, with light fillers -honeycomb
structures, foam, etc., and search for of delamination in laminated plastics.

### Ultrasonic

#### testing method

Resolution of acoustic analysis that is the ability to detect small flaws separately from each
other, is determined by a length of a sound wave

### Visual

#### testing method

is one of the varieties of non—destructive testing methods, primarily based on capabilities of
vision, test object is examined in visible light. It can be used to detect: corrosion damage,
cracks, defects in the material and surface treatment, etc. It is also carried out with the help of
optical devices, which enables to significantly expand the limits of natural eye capabilities.

Technovotum сompany is a developer and manufacturer of non-destructive testing equipment for PCM
(polymer composite materials) products and materials. The company provides services for measurement
and diagnostics of PCM (polymer composite materials), supplies portable diagnostic equipment for
laboratories of PCM (polymer composite materials) manufacturers. We manufacture automated
non-destructive testing systems for PCM (polymer composite materials) and their implementation in
customer's production line.

### Technovotum is a developer and manufacturer of non-destructive testing equipment.

We carry out comprehensive non-destructive testing of products and materials made of PCM (polymer
composite materials).

We provide services for measurement and diagnostics of PCM (polymer composite materials), the supply
of portable diagnostic equipment for laboratories of PCM (polymer composite materials)
manufacturers.
* The portable equipment of Technovotum company is intended for detection of delamination,
  non-adhesives and other integrity failures of polymer-composite materials (PCM), cellular
  structures with various fillers, as well as for determination of corrosion origins, surface and
  subsurface defects in metal structures.
* We manufacture automated non-destructive testing systems for PCM (polymer composite materials) and
  implement them in the customer's production line. Technovotum robotic test benches are designed
  for testing parts made of polymer-composite materials (PCM) used in the aircraft industry:
  airframe elements, helicopter blades, honeycomb panels, as well as wind power, small-scale
  shipbuilding, pipe fittings, automotive industry, etc.
  
  All operations for selection and change of working tools (laser scanner, sensors) in the test
  benches are performed automatically.

## Application

### Application Industries

Six key industries are consumers of PCM (polymer composite materials)

#### [Aerospace][13]

Power structures of housing elements, thermal protection coating, housing panels.

#### [Shipbuilding][14]

Hull structures, foundation frames for engines, fairings of surface ships and submarines,
vibration-insulating coupling joints.

#### [Automotive Industry][15]

Power structures of doors and seats: protective elements of bottom, bumper and radiator mounting
elements, trunk lids, body panels and body elements, brake discs, thermal and sound insulation.

#### [Wind Power Industry][16]

Propeller blades, rotor cap, pods.

#### [Helicopter construction][17]

Main rotor and tail rotor blades, power elements and fuselage skin, sound and vibration isolation.

#### [Aircraft construction][18]

Fuselage, wings, tail, engine pod and interior details.

### Impedance

#### testing method

Application of impedance method in bonded structures with metal and non-metal sheaths with a
thickness of 1.2—1.5 mm (for steel) and up to 2.5 mm for aluminum, with light fillers -honeycomb
structures, foam, etc., and search for of delamination in laminated plastics.

### Ultrasonic

#### testing method

Resolution of acoustic analysis that is the ability to detect small flaws separately from each
other, is determined by a length of a sound wave

### Visual

#### testing method

is one of the varieties of non—destructive testing methods, primarily based on capabilities of
vision, test object is examined in visible light. It can be used to detect: corrosion damage,
cracks, defects in the material and surface treatment, etc. It is also carried out with the help of
optical devices, which enables to significantly expand the limits of natural eye capabilities.

### Eddy current

#### testing method

The peculiarity of eddy current control is that it can be carried out without contact between the
converter and the object. Their interaction occurs at distances sufficient for the free movement of
the transducer relative to the object (from fractions of millimeters to several millimeters).
Therefore, these methods can provide good test results even at high object velocity.

### Impact

#### testing method

Impact-acoustic testing is a method of free vibrations, based on excitation of freely attenuated
elastic vibrations in a test object or part of it and an analysis of these vibrations parameters.

## Hebei PEKA Building Materials
## Co., Ltd.

**PEKA Building Materials** has been established for more than 10 years, producing, selling, and
developing customized building materials products such as *aluminum curtain walls*, *aluminum
ceilings*, *aluminum honeycomb panels*, *aluminum air-conditioning covers*, and *aluminum perforated
panels*. As a leading curtain wall manufacturer from Hebei, China, PEKA serves global construction
markets with precision-engineered solutions.

Founded in 2009 and covering an area of 10,000 square meters, PEKA is a pioneer in the production of
metal decorative materials in China. With more than fifteen years of expertise in *aluminum
shutters*, *curtain walls*, and *aluminum ceiling panels*, the company achieves annual sales of 160
million yuan and ships approximately 580,000 square meters annually. Our 100+ skilled employees
operate within an 8,000 m² production facility equipped with a full suite of large-scale, precision
manufacturing equipment.

With a professional vision, honest management, and an innovative development mindset, PEKA unites
all forces to create high-quality products — facing the global market and serving clients worldwide.

**About Us
**
The engineering works of present day demands the use of materials that satisfy a number of
properties as well as satisfy the aesthetic sense. The relevance of composites increases in the
modern world owing to the high cost in manufacturing of premium quality high performing metals. The
combination of two or more materials result in the formation of a composite. The composites satisfy
a number of properties that is demanded by the current engineering industry.

Permail Wallace** is one of the leading companies in **manufacturing, exporting and supplying** a

Foundries, Petroleum, etc.

supply to our valued customer like Crompton Greaves include** Wood Based Composites, Glass
Reinforced Composites, Resinoid Castings Composites  Moulding Components etc.

## Import and export with us is easy

### Step by step plan for import and export

###### Search for a supplier

We will find a reliable supplier and organize delivery from our own warehouse or production
facility.

###### transaction execution

We will help you conclude a foreign trade transaction, prepare permitting documentation, and obtain
all necessary permits, certificates, and licenses.

###### payments in any currency

We will make payment under the contract in dollars, euros, yuan or any other currency worldwide.
Payment execution period is 3-4 business days. Commission from 3% depending on the payment amount.

###### logistics for foreign trade

We will take care of all logistics and customs clearance in accordance with Incoterms 2020 delivery
terms.

###### our responsibility

We are responsible for the entire process of exporting your products, as well as for transport and
customs operations and all the paperwork. We inform you about the delivery of goods in real time.

###### obligations

We guarantee strict compliance with contractual obligations and deadlines for import or export
deliveries.

## WHY ACP COMPOSITES?

Since 1985, ACP Composites has specialized in designing and manufacturing custom composite
structures, plates, flat panels, and other customized products that change the way the world
approaches complex operating environments. By following the basic principle of “customer-centric
innovation,” ACP Composites has remained focused on developing products that meet the specialty
needs of customers in high-performance and critical industries. With a penchant for high-quality
composites, affordable options, and decades of successful customer partnerships under its belt, ACP
is driven to become the leading custom composite manufacturer for clients in the aerospace,
recreational, medical, and industrial sectors.

## Our Products

[AddCell][18]

Tailored robotic cell solutions with flexible configurations, stringent safety standards, and
end-to-end integration to elevate your manufacturing efficiency and safety.

[ADD Filament Winding System][19]

Versatile winding system for Towpreg, Thermoset, Thermoplastic, Dry fiber materials. Functions as
AFP or Filament Winding as per geometry & material needs. Enables faster and precise production of
pressure vessels, sleeves, inserts.

[AddPath][20]

Streamline and optimize automated composite production with tailored path planning, simulation, and
real-time monitoring for precision and efficiency in fiber placement.

[AddPrint][21]

Advanced slicing and path generation software for SCF3D, designed to optimize Continuous Fiber 3D
printing with best practice-driven functionality and control.

[ADDX][22]

Revolutionizing 3D printing with Structural Continuous Fiber for enhanced strength, precision, and
material efficiency in functional component manufacturing.

[AFP-X][23]

Reduce downtime and increases throughput, the AFP-X offers a four-tow system with increased capacity
& advanced sensors for high-volume manufacturing.

[AFP-XS][24]

The flagship AFP-XS system is a versatile, compact, and precise automated fiber placement solution
ideal for research or small scale production.

## Testimonials

[qt-small ]
Material Versatility
Françis Sedeilhan, Compositadour

The AFP-XS is a high quality, easy to use, repeatable system that quickly swaps over from a standard
thermoset system to handle dry fibers and thermoplastics, seamlessly integrating with the humm3.
This will enable us to further develop the fiber placement research and local SME activity at
Compositadour. We are excited to collaborate with Addcomposites.

[qt-small ]
Smart & Compact AFP Tool
Cyran Le Guennec, IRMA

The AFP-XS is a smart and compact AFP process tool. IRMA has clearly found it useful for composite
prototyping and custom production of material testing. AddPath offers a user-friendly interface for
programming and simulating lay-up. The Addcomposites team clearly knows the way to properly meet the
need of their customer at any time.

[qt-small ]
Efficient Integration
Rik Tonnaer, SAM|XL

Addcomposites has successfully and efficiently integrated their tool into an existing robot cell
with a complex layout, and with much legacy equipment already integrated. We look forward to working
with Addcomposites, continuously sharing knowledge at TU Delft.

[qt-small ]
Project Vision Alignment
Yoann Bonnefon, IND Group

IND Group has chosen to partner with Addcomposites with the goal of developing a complete composites
manufacturing cell using the AFP-XS. It is the only fiber placement system that fit our
requirements, and the vision was aligned from the start.

[qt-small ]
Improved Employee Safety
Jussi Valtonen, Exel Composites

Addcomposites was given the goal of improving employee safety by process automation. With their
innovative approach, technical know-how, and professional communication, they have delivered the
project successfully and in a timely manner.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

##### Composite Material Manufacturing:

Haining ANJIE Composite Materials Co. Ltd., is a reputable and established manufacturer of composite
materials,specializing in the production of carbon fiber,basalt fiber,aramid fiber,and fiberglass
products. With a strong presence in Haining City Zhejiang province,China since its establishment in
2004,ANJIE has built a robust brand known for its competitive pricing,superior quality,and
exceptional customer service with 20 years of experience in composite materials industry. Jiangsu
NONGCHAOER Composite Materials Co. Ltd.,is a dynamic and forward-thinking sister company of ANJIE
Composite,established in 2019 and located in Jianhu High-tech Park,Yancheng City,Jiangsu Province
with a total area of about 20,000 square meters. With a commitment to excellence and
innovation,NONGCHAOER focuses on the manufacturing,development and application of advanced composite
materials to meet the growing demand in the market worldwide. Equipped with large facilities and
advanced machinery,it currently has more than 120 sets of various types of production equipment and
laboratory equipment. In 2022,it successfully passed the certification of "National Science and
Technology small and medium-sized enterprises",in 2023 it successfully passed the quality management
system certification,environmental management system certification,occupational health and safety
management system certification,SGS certification,and selected as the first batch of Yancheng
Engineering Technology Research Center.

## What We Do

Axiom Materials, Inc. is a leading manufacturer of advanced composite materials, specializing in
ceramic matrix composites (CMCs), prepregs, honeycomb core, film adhesives, and ancillary composite
products. Our mission is to deliver high-quality materials with exceptional customer service and
innovative design.

We pride ourselves on our agility and flexibility, working closely with clients globally in
aerospace, military, automotive, industrial, sports, and medical industries to develop cutting-edge
& next-generation solutions.

Axiom Materials, Inc. is proudly AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certified, ensuring the highest standards
in our operations. Since being acquired by KORDSA in 2019, we have continued to expand our
capabilities and reach.

## CIKONI: CFK-Engineering für Pioniere

CIKONI ist ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurbüro für innovative Leichtbau- und Faserverbundlösungen mit
fortgeschrittenen Verbundwerkstoffen, wie kohlefaserverstärktem Kunststoff (CFK).

CIKONI – das bedeutet ganzheitliche spezialisierte Ingenieurdienstleistungen entlang der gesamten
Prozesskette und schließt die Entwicklung von Leichtbauprodukten und den notwendigen
Fertigungsverfahren ein. Mit unserem Expertenteam schließen wir im Kundenauftrag Technologie- und
Wissenslücken und realisieren einen meßbaren Beitrag zu geringerem Energieverbrauch, höherer
Performance und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Zur Detaillierung und Absicherung von Strukturkomponenten nutzen wir modernste
Konstruktionswerkzeuge, zukunftsweisende Simulationsmethoden und fasergerechte FEM-Berechnung (z.B.
Festigkeit, Steifigkeit, Crash). In der Prozessentwicklung realisieren wir skalierbare und
automatisierbare Lösungen für die effiziente Fertigung von Carbonbauteilen.

[FEM Simulation von CFK Bauteilen]

## Was machen wir im CFK-Leichtbau?

[ Leichtbau][32] [ Testing][33] [ Automation][34] [ Drucktanks][35]

Leichtbau ist ein Entwicklungsprinzip, bei dem wir die Erfüllung einer Funktion mit möglichst
geringem Einsatz an Material und damit Gewicht realisieren. Dabei setzen wir sowohl
leichtbaubezogene Konstruktionsprinzipien als auch Hochleistungswerkstoffe wie CFK/Carbon ein, um
das Gewichtsziel zu erreichen. Ein wichtiges Werkzeug ist die anisotrope Finite Elemente Simulation,
die es uns erlaubt Konzepte frühzeitig zu validieren und in späten Projektphasen weitgehend zu
optimieren.

Unser übergeordnetes Ziel ist es dabei , das richtige wirtschaftliches Maß für jeden Kunden zu
finden. Zwischen Ultraleichtbau, wie er im Rennsport oder der Luftfahrt praktiziert wird und einer
reinen Optimierung identifizieren wir die richtige Stufe für jeden Kunden und jeden Anwendungsfall.
Dabei dienen uns Hybridkonstruktionen aus Metall und Verbundwerkstoffen oftmals als Enabler.

Mehr zur [Entwicklung von CFK-Bauteilen][36].

Für den Leichtbau spielt das Testing für uns eine doppelte Rolle. Einerseits sind wir gerade bei
komplexen Faserverbundwerkstoffen auf umfangreiche Inputdaten für die Simulation angewiesen.
Andererseits werden Leichtbauteile oftmals an die Grenzen ihrer Belastbarkeit hin entwickelt. Daher
müssen sie über Komponentenversuche bezüglich ihrer Funktionserfüllung validiert werden.

Bei CIKONI arbeiten wir mit mehr als 20 verschiedenen Laboren, Prüfzentren und Versuchseinrichtungen
zusammen. Dies erlaubt uns die durchgängige Realisierung von Versuchen vom Coupon bis zum
Systemversuch zu wirtschaftlichen Konditionen und mit durchgängiger technischer Begleitung anbieten
zu können.

Mehr zum [Testing mit Verbundwerkstoffen][37].

Der Großteil der Fertigung von Carbon Composites erfolgt nach wie vor über manuelle

## CIKONI: CFK-Engineering für Pioniere

CIKONI ist ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurbüro für innovative Leichtbau- und Faserverbundlösungen mit
fortgeschrittenen Verbundwerkstoffen, wie kohlefaserverstärktem Kunststoff (CFK).

CIKONI – das bedeutet ganzheitliche spezialisierte Ingenieurdienstleistungen entlang der gesamten
Prozesskette und schließt die Entwicklung von Leichtbauprodukten und den notwendigen
Fertigungsverfahren ein. Mit unserem Expertenteam schließen wir im Kundenauftrag Technologie- und
Wissenslücken und realisieren einen meßbaren Beitrag zu geringerem Energieverbrauch, höherer
Performance und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Zur Detaillierung und Absicherung von Strukturkomponenten nutzen wir modernste
Konstruktionswerkzeuge, zukunftsweisende Simulationsmethoden und fasergerechte FEM-Berechnung (z.B.
Festigkeit, Steifigkeit, Crash). In der Prozessentwicklung realisieren wir skalierbare und
automatisierbare Lösungen für die effiziente Fertigung von Carbonbauteilen.

[FEM Simulation von CFK Bauteilen]

## Was machen wir im CFK-Leichtbau?

[ Leichtbau][32] [ Testing][33] [ Automation][34] [ Drucktanks][35]

Leichtbau ist ein Entwicklungsprinzip, bei dem wir die Erfüllung einer Funktion mit möglichst
geringem Einsatz an Material und damit Gewicht realisieren. Dabei setzen wir sowohl
leichtbaubezogene Konstruktionsprinzipien als auch Hochleistungswerkstoffe wie CFK/Carbon ein, um
das Gewichtsziel zu erreichen. Ein wichtiges Werkzeug ist die anisotrope Finite Elemente Simulation,
die es uns erlaubt Konzepte frühzeitig zu validieren und in späten Projektphasen weitgehend zu
optimieren.

Unser übergeordnetes Ziel ist es dabei , das richtige wirtschaftliches Maß für jeden Kunden zu
finden. Zwischen Ultraleichtbau, wie er im Rennsport oder der Luftfahrt praktiziert wird und einer
reinen Optimierung identifizieren wir die richtige Stufe für jeden Kunden und jeden Anwendungsfall.
Dabei dienen uns Hybridkonstruktionen aus Metall und Verbundwerkstoffen oftmals als Enabler.

Mehr zur [Entwicklung von CFK-Bauteilen][36].

Für den Leichtbau spielt das Testing für uns eine doppelte Rolle. Einerseits sind wir gerade bei
komplexen Faserverbundwerkstoffen auf umfangreiche Inputdaten für die Simulation angewiesen.
Andererseits werden Leichtbauteile oftmals an die Grenzen ihrer Belastbarkeit hin entwickelt. Daher
müssen sie über Komponentenversuche bezüglich ihrer Funktionserfüllung validiert werden.

Bei CIKONI arbeiten wir mit mehr als 20 verschiedenen Laboren, Prüfzentren und Versuchseinrichtungen
zusammen. Dies erlaubt uns die durchgängige Realisierung von Versuchen vom Coupon bis zum
Systemversuch zu wirtschaftlichen Konditionen und mit durchgängiger technischer Begleitung anbieten
zu können.

Mehr zum [Testing mit Verbundwerkstoffen][37].

Fertigungsverfahren. Die Kosten manueller Fertigung übersteigen dabei die Materialkosten um ein
Vielfaches. Bei CIKONI entwickeln wir daher sowohl Leichtbauteile, die effizient gefertigt werden
können, realisieren aber auch Fertigungsprozesse und automatisierte Maschinen für die Herstellung
der Komponenten.

Ein besonderer Fokus ist dabei die Skalierbarkeit unserer Fertigungskonzepte, so dass mit
überschaubaren Mitteln ein Einstieg in die (Teil-)Automatisierung erfolgen kann, das
Fertigungsprinzip jedoch bei Bedarf multipliziert werden kann. Unser Schwerpunkt sind die

Mehr zur [Automatisierung im Leichtbau][38].

Composite-Werkstoffe bietet durch ihre hohe Zugfestigkeit das Potenzial zur Herstellung leichter
Druckspeicher für Wasserstoff, CNG oder andere hochverdichtete Gase. Dabei spielt die effiziente
Auslegung der Druckbehälter eine übergeordnete Rolle, da die Kosten durch maßgeblich durch den
Composite-Anteil begründet werden. Je effizienter ein Druckbehälter konstruiert und ausgelegt ist,
desto wettbewerbsfähiger wird er somit.

CIKONI bietet umfangreiches technisches Expertenwissen in der Auslegung und Dimensionierung von
Drucktanks, welches wir bereits bei führenden OEMs und Drucktankherstellern für verschiedenste
Branchen eingebracht haben.

[ Read more about us][8]

In the dynamic world of composite materials, where **performance**, **know how**, and the relentless
pursuit of **perfection **are not just goals but the essence of every endeavor. Handling
fiber-reinforced materials requires not just skill but a passion for pushing the boundaries of
what’s possible, blending an array of materials through processes that are as complex as they are
critical. Every step, every decision, reflects a commitment to excellence, with the quality of your
output distinguishing groundbreaking success from the ordinary.

In this intricate dance of precision, where **countless individuals, suppliers, materials, and
machines** come together to weave the very fabric of tomorrow’s structures, CompositeOS emerges as
the perfect tool to manage this complexity. Crafted exclusively for the nuanced demands of composite
material manufacturing, it is more than software—it is a celebration of the industry’s unyielding
drive towards perfection.

###### Designed for Composite Materials Manufacturing

Composite materials competence, software expertise and customer orientation from a single source.

Whether you manufacture components using the autoclave prepreg process or resin transfer moulding,
we have the composite-specific tools, customizable modules and expertise to digitalize your
processes. In addition, compositeOS offers a number of characteristics that are aimed precisely at

We believe software must be affordable and deliver measurable efficiency boosts for your operation.

##### Transparency and Oversight

In composites, oversight is key. We provide software based tools to track customer acquisition,
manufacturing progress and quality metrics.

##### Convenience and Support

Typically, software is not a core competence of composite manufacturers. That’s why we devote time
to consult our customers, plan the project transparently and provide support beyond implementation.

##### Digital Empowerment

Digital processes increase employee satisfaction, boost efficiency and offer unlimited new business
opportunities through higher customer satisfaction.

###### Your Composite business reinforced by a digital thread

books. Change flexibly as you wish.

determined working times.

* Get instant optimization feedback and work more efficiently
* Define endless templates for projects to plan faster in a reconfigurable way

* From autoclave to stacking: Made for composite manufacturing

processes. In addition, compositeOS offers a number of characteristics that are aimed precisely at
the success of your composite materials business.
